map.燃油乘用车购置税计税依据为「不含增值税的车价」，即发票价÷1.13，再×10%；: For fuel passenger vehicles the purchase tax base is the price excluding VAT, i.e. invoice price / 1.13, then x 10%. For simplicity this tool estimates directly from the bare vehicle price x tax rate, which is slightly higher than the exact value (about 1.13x). New-energy passenger vehicles are currently exempt from vehicle purchase tax, so you can switch the rate to 0 to compare.
